## Description
Briefly describe the change, rationale, and problem it solves.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Performance improvement

## Checklist
- [ ] Code follows the established architecture boundaries (API -> Core -> Bridges -> Plugin).
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`./gradlew test`).
- [ ] Added new unit tests covering new logic where applicable.
- [ ] Verified on Paper / Folia where applicable.
